state.purpose: Re-challenge the current AI cost-quality champion by applying the same fast-cash + annual-refresh commercial shape to multiple economic events. Optimize for highest realized owner hourly earnings reached quickly, while preserving sellable company assets.

world.commercialShape: one paid bounded audit first; after value is observed, same fixed input/output contract can convert to prepaid annual plan with up to four refreshes; no full platform build before repeated paid demand
world.currentChampion: AI cost-quality offline replay audit → annual refresh

categoryEvidence.AI_COST_QUALITY: AI/cloud cost platforms and model-routing/eval practices show paid demand for AI cost, unit economics and cost-quality optimization.
categoryEvidence.PROCUREMENT: Zylo, Vertice and Tropic show paid demand for software-renewal/spend intelligence and quantified savings outcomes.
categoryEvidence.CLOUD_COST: Vantage and other FinOps platforms show broad paid demand for cloud cost visibility and savings actions.
categoryEvidence.MNA: M&A intelligence/sourcing platforms such as SourceScrub, Inven and Grata show paid demand and strategic acquisition activity in deal intelligence.

world.caveat: Category evidence is adjacent and mostly vendor-reported; it does not prove this exact entrant or delivery shape.

candidates.name: AI-cost-quality-refresh
candidates.claim: AI product company supplies a bounded historical corpus, customer-defined quality criterion and provider/model cost. Factory replays selected alternatives offline and returns reproducible cost-quality frontier, failure cases and projected savings. First paid audit can convert to prepaid annual plan with up to four refreshes when models, prices or workloads change. No production effect authority.

candidates.name: software-renewal-savings-refresh
candidates.claim: Finance/procurement supplies renewal calendar plus contract, quote and available usage facts. Factory returns evidence-backed cancel, downgrade, consolidate, re-quote, renew or investigate actions with annualized savings estimates. First paid renewal audit can convert to prepaid annual plan with up to four refreshes tied to major renewal windows. Customer executes all actions; no negotiation service.

candidates.name: cloud-cost-savings-refresh
candidates.claim: Company supplies bounded read-only cloud/AI billing exports. Factory returns anomaly, idle/waste, concentration and quantified savings actions. First paid snapshot can convert to prepaid annual plan with up to four refreshes. Customer executes all infrastructure effects; no continuous agent or platform required.

candidates.name: M&A-screening-refresh
candidates.claim: M&A advisor supplies its own approved target universe plus acquisition mandate. Factory returns ranked evidence-backed shortlist and standardized target memos. First paid screening audit can convert to prepaid annual plan with up to four refreshes as mandate or universe changes. No proprietary target database, outreach, negotiation, DD or intermediary/FA role.

candidates.name: null-preserve-capital
candidates.claim: Do not commercialize a factory connection yet. Preserve the 5M JPY capital and continue public-market research until a materially stronger thesis emerges.

constraints: No hiring for first paid validation.
First audit must be deliverable mostly automatically from exported files or customer-supplied universe.
No full platform before repeat paid evidence.
No proprietary-data promise the user does not own.
